analysis: Phobos v004 gravity-referenced slope scale analysis

fixed_support.grid: For each W, latitude-longitude cell membership is assigned from native-model facet centroids and reused for every L. Grid edges are anchored at -90 deg latitude and -180 deg longitude. If W does not divide 180/360 exactly, the final edge band is narrower and its actual bounds are written to the CSV.

grid_window_summary: Area-weighted quantiles across nonempty grid cells, summarizing how the gridded statistics depend on the sampling-window width W (reported in Table 3 and Figure 8a of the manuscript).
notes: GPKG geometry/point spacing is not used for cross-scale matching.
Facet matching uses contiguous facet_id and preserved OBJ face order.
Each requested W is an explicit fixed spatial-support scale.
Gridded statistics are conditional on the adopted window width W; L (e-fold smoothing wavelength) and W are independent analysis parameters.
